about.title: What is Golify?
about.p1: Golify is a football (soccer) app for iOS and Android, free to download, built for fans in Mexico and Latin America. It brings together live scores, the FIFA World Cup 2026 schedule and results, prediction tournaments with friends ("retas"), pools ("quinielas"), a digital collectible sticker album, and the EA FC player catalog — all in one place.
about.p2: With Golify you follow your favorite matches with real-time notifications for goals, cards and lineups; create and compete in private retas and quinielas with your group; and explore detailed team and player stats. It covers the world's major leagues, including Liga MX, the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A and more.
about.p3: Golify is free to download and available in Spanish and English. Some premium features require a subscription. Download it from the App Store or Google Play and live the World Cup 2026 with your community. Golify's official website is golify.futbol.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: Golify respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights.

infoWeCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
infoWeCollect.accountData: Account data: email, username, profile photo.
infoWeCollect.usageData: Usage data: matches tracked, retas joined, EA FC catalog interactions.
infoWeCollect.deviceData: Device data: device type, OS version, push notification token.
infoWeCollect.locationData: Location data: only if you grant permission, used for local retas.
infoWeCollect.healthData: Health data: only if you grant permission, read from Apple HealthKit or Google Health Connect for the Pulso wellness feature. Processed exclusively on your device — see the Health Data section below.

howWeUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.provide: Provide and improve the app services.

healthData.title: 3. Health Data (Apple HealthKit & Google Health Connect)
healthData.intro: Golify's Pulso feature is an optional health and wellness experience. If — and only if — you grant explicit permission, Golify reads the following data from Apple HealthKit (iOS / Apple Watch) or Google Health Connect (Android):
healthData.heartRate: Heart rate: samples during the time window of a match you played or watched, used to show your physical effort (peak, average, intensity zones) or your fan stress response.
healthData.hrv: Heart rate variability (HRV): baseline vs. HRV at your heart-rate peak, used to quantify your stress response during a match.
healthData.restingHeartRate: Resting heart rate: your personal baseline, used to normalize effort and stress scores so results are personalized rather than absolute BPM.
healthData.sleep: Sleep: duration of the night following a match compared against your 7-night average, used to show a recovery insight.
healthData.processing: How we process it: all health data is read-only and processed exclusively on your device. It is never uploaded to our servers or any third party, never stored outside your device, never used for advertising or marketing, and never sold or shared. Golify never writes data to HealthKit or Health Connect.
healthData.retention: Retention and deletion: Golify does not retain health data. Samples are read on demand only to compute the analysis you request and are not copied into any database. The resulting insights exist only on your device and are removed when you uninstall the app. Because nothing leaves your device, there is no server-side health data to delete.
healthData.security: Security: health data never leaves your device, which removes transmission and server-breach risk entirely. On-device processing relies on the operating system's sandboxing and encryption (iOS and Android device encryption).
healthData.revoke: Your control: health access is entirely optional — Pulso simply shows no analysis without it. You can revoke access at any time from the Health app (iOS) or Health Connect settings (Android), which immediately stops all reading of health data.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing Your Information
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data with trusted service providers (e.g., cloud hosting, analytics) under strict confidentiality agreements, or when required by law.

yourRights.title: 5. Your Rights
yourRights.text: You can access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time through the app settings or by contacting us at

security.title: 6. Security
security.text: We use industry-standard measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

children.title: 7. Children's Privacy
children.text: Golify is not intended for users under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us immediately.

thirdPartyServices.title: 8. Third-Party Services — Radio Browser API
thirdPartyServices.text: Golify's radio feature uses Radio Browser (api.radio-browser.info), a free, open-source, community-maintained directory of public internet radio stations. Radio Browser requires no authentication or registration; it provides discovery information only: station name, country, and the public stream URL each station has chosen to broadcast openly. Golify does not transmit any personal data to Radio Browser. Audio plays directly from each station's own servers — Golify does not act as a proxy or cache streams. Stations that wish to restrict public access may do so at their own infrastructure level.

radioPolicy.title: Radio Content & Takedown Policy
radioPolicy.intro: This policy covers the Radio feature of the Golify mobile apps. Golify lets listeners tune in to publicly available internet radio streams that broadcasters themselves publish openly. We respect broadcasters' rights and provide a fast, no-questions-asked removal path.

architecture.title: 1. How playback works
architecture.noRehost: Golify does not host, store, proxy, transcode, cache, or record any third-party audio.
architecture.directPlayback: Playback is a direct connection from the listener's device to the streaming server operated by (or on behalf of) each radio broadcaster.
architecture.publicUrls: Stream URLs are the broadcasters' own public endpoints — identical to the ones broadcasters publish on their own websites and players.
architecture.attribution: The app displays station attribution (station name, country, and the station's own logo) during playback.

catalog.title: 2. Catalog and discovery
catalog.source: Station metadata is sourced from Radio Browser (radio-browser.info), an open, community-maintained public directory of internet radio stations. The default catalog surfaces sports and news broadcasters that intentionally and openly publish their live streams to the general public.
catalog.control: Broadcasters retain full technical control of their streams at all times (start, stop, geo-restriction, content). Golify reflects the live stream state without modification.

monetization.title: 3. No monetization of third-party streams
monetization.text: The radio feature is free for all users. It is not gated behind any subscription, and we do not sell or license access to any third-party stream.

takedown.title: 4. Takedown policy
takedown.intro: Any broadcaster or rights holder may request removal of a station by:
takedown.inApp: Using the in-app “Report station” control, available on every station row and on the player, or
takedown.commitment: We will remove the reported station from the catalog within 48 hours of a valid request, without requiring legal process.
